integrity: The Jordan-form and rank formulas are proved by characteristic-p triangular Toeplitz similarity, residue-class shifts, and exact coefficient counts. Verification program independently exhausts twenty small finite-field cases, including nonprime fields. Not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: For ordinary linear derivations of the specified right null-filiform Leibniz algebra L_n over finite fields F_{p^e} only; no algebra-automorphism orbit sizes or deformations. Finite exhaustions establish sample cases, not the infinite proof. Historical originality is subject to unlocated equivalent modular matrix normal forms and independent verification.
title: Modular Jordan census of null-filiform Leibniz derivations
